name: Enchanted Wilds
notes: Set-level parameters as of 18.1. Later changes live in patches/<patch>.json. Shop odds and pool sizes are read from the game files (CommunityDragon 16.20 = 18.4; the 18.1-18.4 notes list no change to them). Nothing is 'verified' until checked in-game or stated by an official source.

shop_odds.source: game file map22.bin.json (CommunityDragon 16.20), TFTSet18 DropRateTables.Shop, matches seemeta; level 7 row from the in-game shop tooltip (owner screenshot, 18.4b); levels 8 and 9 also seen in game
shop_odds.note: Percent per cost tier 1..5 by player level. Game file stores fractions (0.19 ...). Not in any 18.x patch note, so assumed unchanged since 18.1. Level 7: the in-game tooltip shows 16/30/43/10/1, while the game file and the official 17.1 notes say 19/30/40/10/1. The tooltip is what the live game shows, so it is used; whether actual rolls follow it is not proven (it would take a large shop count).

conflicts.note: Game file (only shop table in map22, no 16/30/43 table present) and the 17.1 notes ('Level 7: 16/30/43/10/1% => 19/30/40/10/1%'). The 18.1 Set 18 launch notes mention no odds. The in-game tooltip on 18.4b disagrees.

copies_per_champion.source: game file map22.bin.json (CommunityDragon 16.20), TFTSet18 ShopContentData TierBags Count; matches seemeta

champions_per_cost.source: game file map22.bin.json TierBags (units per tier bag); same counts in the CommunityDragon champion list and tactics.tools
champions_per_cost.note: Lux is in the 5-cost bag once (DA_Lux18_Base); its forms are not separate pool entries. Owner: Lux comes to the shop like any 5-cost with the normal 5-cost copy count, and the form (the traits it gives) is shown in the shop and picked at random (not matched to the player's comp). Once the player owns a Lux, later Lux shop appearances are that same form until it is sold; after selling, any form can come again. Dual-form champions (Adaptor AD/AP, Gnar) are one champion each in the pool; some switch form when their mana or rage fills, Adaptors by whether AD or AP is higher.

shop_slots.source: long-standing TFT shop size; not checked for Set 18
shop_slots.note: Champion slots in a shop without a Wisp. See shop_rules.wisp_slot.

reroll_cost.source: seen in game by the owner on 18.4b

xp_purchase.source: in game on 18.4b: Buy XP button costs 4 gold (owner screenshot) and gives 4 XP (owner)

passive_xp_per_round.source: seen in game by the owner: 2 XP every round (reported 2026-10-18, checked again on 18.4b 2026-10-20)

xp_to_next_level.source: levels 7-9 from the 18.2 notes' old values (60, 68, 68); levels 1-6 from third-party tables
xp_to_next_level.note: Key = current level, value = XP needed to reach the next level. 1->2 is automatic. 18.2 changes 7->8 to 56 (see patches).

max_level.note: shop_odds lists level 11; it may only be reachable with an augment.

base_income.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold
base_income.note: Gold paid at the start of each round, before interest, streak and win gold. 5 from 2-2 on. The owner's stage 4 income readings (owner-ingame-2026-10-20) fit 5; the early-stage values are not checked.

interest_per_10_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold; seen in game: 20 gold gave 2 interest (owner, 18.4b)

interest_cap.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and wiki TFT:Gold

streak_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide (Set 18) and tft.ninja; 2 -> +1 and 6+ -> +3 read in game (owner, 18.4b)
streak_gold.note: [[min streak length, bonus gold]]: 2-4 -> +1, 5 -> +2, 6+ -> +3. Same for win and loss streaks (a loss streak only misses the +1 win gold). In game (owner, 18.4b): 0 gold, 1 win before the round, won -> +7 = 1 win + 5 base + 1 streak, so a 2-round streak pays +1. Step by step: 5 wins before the round, 14 gold before combat, 15 after the win, sold a unit to 20, next round start 30: 10 = 5 base + 2 interest + 3 streak. A loss after a 6 win streak (30 gold) paid 5 + 3 = 8: the streak resets. The owner first said a 2-round streak pays nothing, then measured +1; the measurement is used. Lengths 3-5 not read step by step.

conflicts.note: Wiki income section starts at 3; the owner's in-game reading shows a 2-round streak pays +1.

pvp_win_gold.source: op.gg gold-xp guide, wiki TFT:Gold and tft.ninja
pvp_win_gold.note: Paid when the player combat is won, before interest is computed. Owner (18.4b): a won round pays +1 gold.

sell_value.source: wiki TFT:Gold rule: a unit sells for what it cost (cost x copies) when it is 1-star or 1-cost, otherwise 1 gold less
sell_value.note: Key = cost, list = gold for 1/2/3-star. Derived from the rule, not read from the game. The wiki's own example (3-star 1-cost sells for 5) contradicts the rule; check 2-star and 3-star values in game.

star_multipliers.source: unit stats per star on a stats site the owner pasted (Sett Health 1200/2160/3888, Damage 80/120/180; Morgana 1100/1980/3564, 45/67/101; the other pasted units match)
star_multipliers.note: Health and Attack Damage of a 1/2/3-star unit relative to its 1-star stats. Armor, MR, attack speed and mana do not change with stars on the same pages.

emblem_on_same_trait_counts.source: owner (in game, 2026-10-21): an emblem cannot be put on a champion that already has its trait; it has to go on another champion
emblem_on_same_trait_counts.note: Used by rules/traits.py when counting active traits.

player_damage.source: op.gg gold-xp guide and tft.ninja (stage damage plus 1 per surviving enemy unit, regardless of star level)
player_damage.note: Damage a player takes after losing a player combat. Research also saw 0/2/5/7/9/11/17/150 (attributed to the 14.8 notes, URL not found) and 2/6/7/10/12/17 (tftflow, page not recorded); neither could be sourced well enough to record as a conflict.

value.after_purchase: 5 champions in the later shops of that round
value.hidden_champion_revealed: when the Wisp is bought, otherwise at combat start

wisp_slot.source: Riot patch 18.1 notes ('Wisps appear in every other shop') https://teamfighttactics.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/news/game-updates/teamfight-tactics-patch-18-1 ; rightmost slot: https://wiki.leagueoflegends.com/en-us/TFT:Enchanted_Wilds ; 4 champions + Wisp: https://noxutft.com/guide/wisps , https://blitz.gg/tr/tft/articles/tft-set-18-wisps-guide
wisp_slot.note: When a Wisp is shown, the shop has 4 champions and the Wisp in the rightmost slot. Owner (18.4b, 2026-10-20): a champion is hidden under the Wisp and is revealed at once when the Wisp is bought, otherwise when combat starts; only 1 Wisp can be bought per round; after buying it, the later shops of that round show 5 champions, so players buy a cheap Wisp first when rolling for a 3-star; without a purchase, rerolls show a Wisp again only now and then (the owner says sometimes, the 18.1 notes say every other shop: frequency not settled); not buying costs nothing; Wisp prices vary by type, some are 0 gold. Owner is not sure how often a Wisp shows without a purchase; cheap (0-1 gold) Wisps come up sometimes. Blossom trait (game file text) changes this: (5) Wisps are in every shop, (7) gold after buying a Wisp, (9) 2 Wisps per round; so without Blossom a Wisp is not in every shop. Owner: 1 Wisp per round also with 3-7 Blossom; 9 Blossom is weak and rarely played, so the 2-per-round rule is game-file text only, not seen in play. Current model (to be replaced in B3): every other shop loses one champion slot for the whole roll-down.

value.effect: slot rolls a champion one cost tier higher

inferno_upgrade.source: Inferno trait text and values (CommunityDragon 16.20, DA_18_Inferno LuckySlotCount 1/2/4): 'After combat, N of your shop slots without an Inferno champion ignites, rolling a champion one tier higher'
inferno_upgrade.note: Not yet checked in game: whether it applies only to the first shop after combat or also to rerolls, how a slot already at 5-cost behaves, and whether a slot 'without an Inferno champion' is judged before or after the upgrade.

value.cost_odds: the normal odds of the player's level

riftbeast_shop.source: Riftbeast trait text (CommunityDragon 16.20, DA_Riftbeast18 OverrunCombats 3): '(5) Every 3 combats, your next shop is overrun with Riftbeasts'; owner (2026-10-21): all 5 slots are Riftbeasts, at the normal cost odds of the player's level
riftbeast_shop.note: Unknown: whether rerolls of that shop also show only Riftbeasts (rerolls = null), whether they are drawn from the shared pool, whether a Wisp can appear. Other levels: (3) Alpha Mark gives one Riftbeast its unique buff and can be moved at any time (owner), (7) Riftbeasts grow every 5 s, (10) +2 team size.

shop_holds_copies.source: owner (2026-10-22): a champion shown in any player's shop is out of the pool until that shop is refreshed (rerolled or the next round's shop); with 8 of 9 copies owned and the 9th in an opponent's shop, rolling cannot find it
shop_holds_copies.note: Not modelled yet: the roll solvers draw from the pool without the copies sitting in opponents' shops. A belief layer can estimate it (35 opponent slots, each showing the unit with the tier odds of the opponents' level times copies left / tier copies left).

bad_luck_protection.source: owner (2026-10-21): no protection, shops are pure chance; a unit with copies left in the pool can still miss, and rolling for a unit with no copies left only wastes gold
bad_luck_protection.note: A parameter block for it was seen in Set 11 game files (ACIK_KAYNAK_INCELEME.md 2.5); the TFTSet18 entry in map22.bin.json 16.20 has no field named for it (some fields are hashed). Hidden mechanics cannot be seen in play, so this stays unverified.
